analysis.title: Remote Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong Python, ETL, and data engineering experience, plus practical AI projects (agentic pipeline, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL). However, the role emphasizes full-stack JavaScript (React/Node.js), modern backend frameworks like FastAPI, and production-grade software engineering at high-scale companies. The candidate's professional experience is more in capacity/performance engineering and data pipelines, not full-stack development. Their AI projects are personal or research-oriented, not enterprise production. The role also requires US-based candidates, which matches the candidate's location.
strengths: Expert-level Python and Pandas with extensive ETL development (CITI P95 telemetry pipeline).
Strong data engineering and forecasting skills (scikit-learn, Prophet, PySpark).
Practical AI experience: built agentic job-search pipeline with FAISS, LLM scoring, MCP; designed AWS lakehouse with Text-to-SQL agent.
Experience with large-scale systems (Sabre migration, 6,000+ endpoints) and performance engineering.
gaps: No professional experience with JavaScript/React/Node.js or full-stack development.
No evidence of FastAPI or modern backend frameworks (only Python scripting and ETL).
Professional background is in capacity/performance engineering, not software engineering at high-scale tech companies like Google/Microsoft.
AI projects are personal or research-oriented, not enterprise production deployments.
No experience with AI model training data curation or evaluating AI-generated code.
tailoring_plan: 1. Rewrite headline to 'Backend Engineer with Python and AI-Driven Solutions' to align with role. 2. In summary, emphasize Python expertise and AI projects (agentic pipeline, lakehouse) as evidence of backend and AI capabilities. 3. Add a 'Technical Skills' section listing Python, FastAPI (if you have any exposure, otherwise omit), SQL, ETL, and AI/LLM tools. 4. In experience bullets, highlight Python development and data pipeline work, and quantify impact (e.g., 6,000+ endpoints). 5. Add a 'Projects' section detailing the AI job-search pipeline and lakehouse, emphasizing backend architecture
